integrity: All quantities are exact. The infinite theorem is supported by a case-complete embedding-complement argument; finite computational checks only corroborate it. Priority is assessed against named literature, with an unindexed equivalent still possible.
scientific_limitations: The strong-Wilf classification is proved only when one binary pattern has at most three maximal constant-letter runs; the moment identity is for host length equal to pattern length plus two. Extensions to more runs and larger alphabets remain unproved.
title: A two-insertion moment separates all three-run binary subsequence patterns
